description: This file declares the 'LocalStore' class, which implements the 'ILocalStore' interface for managing a local database using SQLite. It provides methods for opening the database, creating tables, setting entry limits, retrieving counts and entries, removing entries, and adding entries. The class maintains a database connection and path as private members.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that implements local database storage functionalities for the plugin, managing data via SQLite.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the database at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table starting from a specific index, with a maximum count.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Fetches a list of entries from a table starting from a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a table.
